usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and AddCal builds the calendar when “New Task Created in Project” runs “Create Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Event” in AddCal
bestTemplate.why: A new task becomes an AddCal event with a title, time, location and timezone.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Task” only sees tasks from the last 15 minutes, so keep its schedule short.
